summary: Joshua son of Nun sends from Shittim two men as spies secretly saying go view land and Jericho, they go come into house of prostitute Rahab and lodge there, it was told king of Jericho saying behold men came tonight of Israel to search land, king sends to Rahab bring out men who came to you for they came to search all land, woman took two men hid them, says yes men came but I didn't know where from about time gate was being shut they went out where went I don't know pursue quickly overtake, but she had brought them up to roof hid with stalks of flax laid in order. Before they lay down she comes up says I know Yahweh has given you land and dread fallen on us and all inhabitants melt away for we heard how Yahweh dried up Red Sea and what you did to two Amorite kings, for Yahweh your God he is God in heaven above and earth beneath, now therefore swear to me by Yahweh since I dealt kindly please deal kindly with my father's house and give me true token and save alive father mother brothers sisters all theirs and deliver lives from death. Men say our life for yours if you tell not, when Yahweh gives land we will deal kindly and truly. She lets them down by cord through window for her house was upon town wall, says get to mountain hide three days, they say we will be guiltless of your oath unless you bind this line of scarlet thread in window where you let us down and gather father mother brothers father's household into house, whoever goes out of doors blood on own head, whoever in house with you blood on our head if hand on him, if you tell this business we will be guiltless. She says according to words so be it and sends them, binds scarlet line in window.
whyItMatters: Rahab the prostitute hides spies, confesses Yahweh he is God in heaven above and earth beneath, asks for kindness, scarlet thread sign like Passover blood, and is saved — prostitute in genealogy of Jesus, example of faith ranking with Hebrews 11.

keyVerses.text: She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.
keyVerses.why: Rahab's confession — Yahweh is God above and below, dread fallen.

keyVerses.text: Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;
keyVerses.why: Kindness hesed for kindness — asks true token.

keyVerses.text: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.
keyVerses.why: Scarlet line as sign, like Passover blood.

questions.question: Why does Rahab lie to king's men and hide spies? Is lying justified?
questions.answer: Rahab says men came but I didn't know where from, went out at gate shut where went I don't know pursue quickly — false report to protect spies. Ethical dilemma: lying vs saving lives. Narrative presents her as heroine of faith (Hebrews 11:31, James 2:25) not as liar to emulate generally, but her faith expressed as protecting messengers at risk. Like midwives in Exodus 1 who lie to Pharaoh to save babies, praised. For zero-background: Bible includes morally complex people doing imperfect faith, not as endorsement of lying as norm but as faith in Yahweh over king.

questions.question: What does Rahab's confession 'Yahweh your God he is God in heaven above and earth beneath' mean from prostitute?
questions.answer: Confession is remarkable: I know Yahweh has given you land, dread fallen, all inhabitants melt, we heard how Yahweh dried up Red Sea and two Amorite kings defeated, for Yahweh your God he is God in heaven above and earth beneath — same phrase as Deuteronomy 4:39. Rahab, Canaanite prostitute, confesses exclusive deity of Yahweh based on hearing what Yahweh did. She acts on that confession, asking kindness (hesed) and true token (ot emet — reliable sign). Foreshadows Gentile inclusion.

questions.question: Why scarlet line in window? Connection to Passover?
questions.answer: Scarlet thread/cord (tiqvat chut ha-shani) bound in window where she let them down by cord through window house on wall. Spies say bind this line of scarlet thread in window and gather family into house, whoever out of doors blood on own head, whoever in house blood on our head. Parallels Passover: blood on doorposts lintel, stay inside house, blood protects, outside blood on own head. Scarlet color reminiscent of blood, line as token (ot) true. Rahab's house on wall — only part of wall not falling? House becomes ark of salvation. Scarlet line becomes sign of faith.

glossary.def: Likely a prostitute (the Hebrew zonah); some scholars have suggested an innkeeper or independent businesswoman, but the plain sense of the word is prostitute.
Loyal lovingkindness, covenant loyalty beyond duty — Rahab showed to spies, asks same for family.
Tiqvat chut shani — scarlet thread as sign/token, like Passover blood, protection marker.
